Sunset Itinerary: Pinus Pengger + HeHa Sky View

A popular sunset itinerary connects Pinus Pengger for sunset photos, then HeHa Sky View for the night view. This page gives the order and return plan.

Updated 28 October 2026

Sunset–night
2 stops
Patuk corridor
after Dlingo
Return
plan before dark

Detail

Sample order

Arrive at Pinus Pengger 60–90 minutes before sunset for photos, then continue to HeHa Sky View in the Patuk corridor before full dark.

Detail

Time per stop

  • Pinus Pengger: 1–2 hours toward sunset.
  • Inter-corridor travel: allow a buffer.
  • HeHa Sky View: after sunset for the night view.

Detail

Return plan

Visibility drops after dark. Agree on a return ride early and ensure the hill road is safe.

Check HeHa's status via the official site; do not assume always open.

Frequently asked questions

Does this sunset itinerary make sense?

Yes, as a link between two different corridors. Arrange inter-corridor travel and return time.

When to leave Pengger?

Arrive 60–90 minutes before sunset for photos, then go to HeHa before dark.

How long at HeHa?

Depends on availability; check the official site for hours. Do not assume always open.

What if it rains?

Postpone or limit; sunset and night views depend heavily on weather.
